metadata.title: Opinion: The S&P 500 has become a big AI bet. Here are some simple alternatives. - MarketWatch

content.text:
Brett Arends's ROI
Opinion: The S&P 500 has become a big AI bet. Here are some simple alternatives.
The large-cap index is nowhere near as diversified as you think
If the turmoil in artificial-intelligence and technology stocks gets any worse, millions of Americans — actually, tens of millions of Americans — are suddenly going to discover that their retirement funds are far less diversified than they thought.
They are going to find out that a shockingly large part of their entire portfolio was being gambled on these AI and technology stocks.
